This '''unidentified [[Deck officer/Legends|Deck officer]]''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] crewmember aboard [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Osvald Teshik]]'s [[Shepherd|flagship]]. When [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] prepared an ambush for the Grand [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]], by sending him on [[Battle of Andalia|mission]] to the [[Andalia system/Legends|Andalia system]], the officer was still present in his flagship and [[Death/Legends|died]] in the ensuing fight.
